source: The official bilingual Panama Customs portal and its first live form page were read on 2026-08-30. The form exposes required controls and standard date and email input types, but no public regexes, maxlengths or validation messages. No hidden pattern is claimed.

declaration_type.label: Declaration type
declaration_type.help: Choose entry into or exit from the country to match the current movement.

customs_checkpoint.label: Customs entry or exit point
customs_checkpoint.help: Choose the Panama customs checkpoint used for this trip from the live list.

first_names.label: First names
first_names.help: Copy the given names from the travel document.

last_names.label: Last names
last_names.help: Copy the surnames from the travel document.

nationality.label: Nationality
nationality.help: Select the nationality of the passport used for this movement.

document_number.label: Passport number
document_number.help: Use the number from the passport carried to customs. No public format rule is stated.

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: Match the travel document. The live form labels this field for travellers aged 18 or older.

email.label: Email address
email.help: The live form requires the email address twice. Use an inbox available during travel.

customs_answers.label: Goods and values declaration
customs_answers.help: Answer the goods, food, animals and money questions truthfully. Customs may inspect the declaration.
